notes: Two-page payslip. Section 12 (OBUSTAVE) starts on page 1 and continues onto page 2, where section 13 (IZNOS ZA ISPLATU) also lives. This is the golden set's only genuine multi-page case.
Section 13 is the source of iznosZaIsplatu; section 11 (UKUPNA PRIMANJA) is 2416.51 and is not stored.
Six obustave rows are a percentage of neto plaća. Verified: 2298.97 x 0.61% = 14.02, x 0.26% = 5.98, x 0.35% = 8.05, x 0.80% = 18.39, x 0.20% = 4.60, x 0.65% = 14.94.
The source PDF renders some Ć glyphs as '?' (e.g. it prints 'POSMRTNA PRIPOMO?'). Naziv values here use the intended spelling; an extraction that reproduces the '?' is not wrong about the document.
